name: mirai-station
description: Always-on options dealer-positioning research station. SPX: the gravity engine (GexBox) + flow sensor feeding three paper heads (Fade Lens, Watchtower, Break Lens). SNDK: an isolated second station with its own model-written reading. Plus the SIEGE and LOB-FLOW shadow sensors, the dated-book sidecar, the Nightglass tablet (:8787) and the spoken desk (:8788). Everything is graded nightly by report cards behind a Wilson promotion gate; nothing trades. Runs unattended on a Mac mini via launchd.
author: fivestone
